Maria Chen: heads-up 1: rolled kernel-fusion + micro-sparsity allocator to a 3% canary for helix-7b. initial signals good :eyes:
Nate: nice! numbers?
Maria Chen: brief canary snapshot below. measured on live canary + perf bench: 
```
canary: 3% traffic
model: helix-7b-v1
p50(before): 88ms -> (after): 72ms  (-18.2%)
p95(before): 230ms -> (after): 202ms (-12.2%)
p99(before): 610ms -> (after): 562ms (-7.9%)
per-token-cost(before): $0.00180 -> (after): $0.00153 (-15.0%)
5xx/errors: stable (no increase)
memory-tail: +2.3% (within threshold)
```
Samir: impressive cost drop. any quality regressions?
Maria Chen: ran reg eval suite (conversational / coding prompts) 1: token agreement ~99.4%, perplexity delta negligible. extended evals running overnight.
Olga: on-prem / Dedicated implications?
Maria Chen: default safe for Dedicated until we certify the kernel on older CUDA drivers. adding opt-in knob: runtime.kernel.fuse_sparsealloc = true for Dedicated customers. no changes for hosted defaults.
Priya: SLO/alerts? p95/p99 improved but add an alert deck for any sudden memory or error increases.
Infra-Auto: deploy initiated by maria@infra at 2025-03-10T09:14:09Z 1: job=deploy-helix7b-5982; canary=3%.
Nate: can we have a dashboard card showing before/after deltas per-model? ops would like cost view & p95 time series.
Maria Chen: yes, creating a short dashboard + rollback alert. will share link soon.
Product-Luke: great -- flag this for product update next week as a "lower unit cost" win.
Samir: regression triggers? thresholds?
Maria Chen: auto-rollback on: 1) token-quality drop >1.5% top-1 agreement OR 2) p99 increase >5% OR 3) error-rate spike >2x baseline. feature flag: runtime.kernel.fuse_sparsealloc.
Olga: any known edgecases? long-seq workloads?
Maria Chen: slight perf variance on >2048 token contexts; we're adding a fallback path for long sequences.
Priya: tagging eng-oncall and infra-sre for the rollout window.
Maria Chen: rolling to 25% now -> 70% in 4h -> 100% in 12h if no regressions. will post 24h summary here.
Nate: thanks team 1: excited to see the cost savings translate into billing.
Maria Chen: thanks all, ping me if you see strange token pops or hallucination patterns.
Infra-Auto: canary progression: 3% -> 25% at 2025-03-10T09:28:33Z.
